title: Concept: Account restriction reason disclosed
description: An account or card status field with a restriction reason in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The reason tells the reader whether an account is frozen for fraud, lien or court order, which is exactly the context a social engineer needs to talk a call centre into an override.
applicability: Deployments that render an account or card status field with a restriction reason into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The reason tells the reader whether an account is frozen for fraud, lien or court order, which is exactly the context a social engineer needs to talk a call centre into an override.
